cases.name: Werewolf Ransacker
cases.text:
Whenever this creature transforms into Werewolf Ransacker, you may destroy target artifact. If that artifact is put into a graveyard this way, this creature deals 3 damage to that artifact's controller.
At the beginning of each upkeep, if a player cast two or more spells last turn, transform this creature.

cases.name: Nezumi Graverobber
cases.text: {1}{B}: Exile target card from an opponent's graveyard. If no cards are in that graveyard, flip this creature.

cases.name: Tuktuk Scrapper
cases.text: Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, you may destroy target artifact. If that artifact is put into a graveyard this way, this creature deals damage to that artifact's controller equal to the number of Allies you control.
